title: How fresh the numbers are
description: When the page fetched its numbers, the latest app event in the warehouse and when it was loaded, and the latest booking-fee payment in the backend records. All IST. Also when Futwork call data was last synced.

args.sql:
-- When the numbers were fetched, and how fresh each source is (all IST).
SELECT TO_VARCHAR(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS FETCHED,
  (SELECT MAX(TIMESTAMP) FROM PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CUSTOMER_API.CLEVERTAP_EVENTS
     WHERE TIMESTAMP >= TO_VARCHAR(DATEADD(day, -3, CURRENT_DATE()), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS APP_UP_TO,
  (SELECT TO_VARCHAR(MAX(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', _FIVETRAN_SYNCED))::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CUSTOMER_API.CLEVERTAP_EVENTS
     WHERE TIMESTAMP >= TO_VARCHAR(DATEADD(day, -3, CURRENT_DATE()), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS APP_LOADED,
  (SELECT TO_VARCHAR(MAX(DATEADD('second', 19800, added_time)), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.BOOKINGVANILLA_AUDIT
     WHERE event_name = 'booking_fee_captured' AND added_time >= DATEADD(day, -2, CURRENT_DATE())) AS PAY_UP_TO,
  (SELECT TO_VARCHAR(MAX(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', _FIVETRAN_SYNCED))::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.FUTWORK_CALLS_DATA
     WHERE UPLOADED_AT >= DATEADD(day, -3, CURRENT_DATE())) AS FW_UP_TO
